title: Writer Technology Infinite Canvas Lsp
description: Create a new writer technology: full-blown text editor on infinite canvas (Vello/WebGPU via infinite/cavas), real JSON-RPC LSP client/server in Web Worker, writer playground with jack fixture, jack language server (lint/format/hover/completion), integrate WriterCanvas into trinity/jack shell replacing CodeEditor.
summary: Enter now inserts newlines where jack syntax allows readability breaks (after keywords, commas, closing parens, complete identifiers) instead of only opening completions. Added jackNewlineAllowedAt/writerNewlineAllowedAt in writer-core with tests. React handles Enter explicitly: newline when allowed, Tab accepts completions, Ctrl/Cmd+Space still triggers suggestions.
